notes: «كتب الرضا علي بن موسى إلى محمد بن سنان فيما كتب من جواب مسائله» : the recipient is the one whose questions the letter answers, so he is the asker and goes first, the Imam last (as in the owner ruling on «كتب X إلى Y»)
the Imam is written in the opening, and his letter is the saying, so he is the last link as the report names him
